description: Adding a new GeneralName variant to name_matches_subtree/same_nc_variant requires also adding NC_TYPE_* constant AND updating name_type_bit. Nothing enforces this. A contributor who adds DNS-over-IPv6 or RegisteredID support to the matching functions and forgets name_type_bit would leave that name type permanently unconstrained even when permittedSubtrees contains entries for it. Silent NC bypass for the new type. → Add a static assertion or centralize the type→bit mapping so the compiler catches incompleteness.
title: nc_constrained_types bitmask has no compile-time completeness guarantee
